reproducibility.limitations: Full private original editor, authentic original TER work planes and editable .I76 workspace were NOT executed. Four terrain getter/setter services are synthetic; one exploratory raster-only script also stubs native neighbor thunk. Ghidra x87 rounding differs from hardware on prior v26 probes, so occupied-cell coordinates are conditional on this emulator. Historical original code and raw proprietary assets excluded.
